relationships.subject: Suzetrigine
relationships.evidence_quote: suzetrigine (VX-548), the first US Food and Drug Administration (FDA)-approved Nav1.8 inhibitor for acute pain

relationships.subject: peripheral nociceptors
relationships.evidence_quote: given their selective expression in peripheral nociceptors and critical roles in pain signal transmission

key_findings: Nav1.7 and Nav1.8 are promising non-opioid pain targets due to selective expression in peripheral nociceptors.
Challenges in earlier sodium channel inhibitor trials include functional redundancy, species differences and on-target side effects.
